paragraphs.text: A home weather station usually consists of an outdoor sensor unit and an indoor display. The sensors are mounted on a pole at least two metres above the ground, away from walls that could store heat.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: At the top of the unit, three small cups called an anemometer spin in the wind; the faster they turn, the higher the wind speed. Beside them, a vane points in the direction the wind is coming from.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Rain falls into a funnel and fills a tiny bucket that tips over each time it collects a set amount, sending a signal to the display. Temperature and humidity are measured inside a white shield with slatted sides, which protects the sensors from direct sunlight.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The indoor display receives the data by radio and can store a year of readings.
paragraphs.label: D

paragraphs.text: Many home weather stations can also share their readings online, where they help to build detailed maps of local weather conditions.
paragraphs.label: E

explanation.en: “three small cups called an anemometer” → anemometer. Copy the term letter by letter.

explanation.ru: «three small cups called an anemometer» → anemometer. Термин переписываем буква в букву.

items.quote: a vane points in the direction the wind is coming from

explanation.ru: «a vane points in the direction the wind is coming from» → vane. «Wind» уже подписан на схеме.

explanation.en: “Rain falls into a funnel” → funnel. “Bucket” is the next part below (4).
explanation.kk: «Rain falls into a funnel» → funnel. «Bucket» — оның астындағы келесі бөлік (4).
explanation.ru: «Rain falls into a funnel» → funnel. «Bucket» — следующая часть под ним (4).

items.quote: fills a tiny bucket that tips over each time it collects a set amount

explanation.en: “a tiny bucket that tips over” → bucket. “Tipping” is already on the label.
explanation.kk: «a tiny bucket that tips over» → bucket. «Tipping» сызбада тұр.
explanation.ru: «a tiny bucket that tips over» → bucket. «Tipping» уже на схеме.

items.quote: measured inside a white shield with slatted sides

explanation.en: “inside a white shield with slatted sides” → shield. The “display” is indoors, not on the pole.
explanation.kk: «inside a white shield with slatted sides» → shield. «Display» — үй ішінде, бағанадағы бөлік емес.
explanation.ru: «inside a white shield with slatted sides» → shield. «Display» — внутри дома, это не часть на столбе.
